t: Screwfix Christmas socks offer a comfortable and warm solution for cold weather, featuring a multi-colour design. These cotton-rich socks, made with an 80% cotton blend and recycled polyester, are ideal for trade professionals seeking warmth on site or a festive touch at home. Knitted cuffs provide a secure fit, and the socks are machine washable for easy maintenance. Each pack contains three unique designs, showcasing favourite products and the Screwfix logo. Purchases also support The Screwfix Foundation, a registered grant giving charity that helps both national and local organisations.
